title: Entitled ‘Karen’ Loses Her Mind When Cops Show Up at Her House
description:
A woman was arrested days after allegedly throwing a drink on a man in Champaign, Illinois. On September 20, 2024 police took Chongya Weldon, 39, into custody after a man complained she came into a business and splashed a drink on him. Officers said this was not the first incident between the two and went to Chongya’s home where a chaotic arrest unfolded. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
